Obverse description: Bust laureate draped ?and cuirassed? right. Obverse inscription: IMP C M AVR SEV ALEXAN[----]. Reverse description: ?Pax advancing left with ?sceptre aslant and palm. Reverse inscription: PAX AVG. Diameter: 19.9mm, Weight: 1.95gms, die axis: 6
